BUILT TO FIT THE MOMENT

One message.
A useful next step.

A strong banner is a focused composition. Give the headline priority, keep the logo readable and adapt the layout to its actual placement. Both digital web banners and app banners share the 1080 × 600 px canvas with 48 px safe insets.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
Asset & themeDimensions & safe insetUse & specifications
Digital web banner · Brand Green1080 × 600 px · 48 px insetPrimary website header and campaign banner. Uses Brand Green #39823C background with yellow logo.
App banner · Brand Yellow1080 × 600 px · 48 px insetMobile app carousel and category promotions. Uses Brand Yellow #F3CB2D background with green logo.
Category banners · Complementary palettes1080 × 600 px · 48 px insetRetail promotional banners using category-specific mood colors (Chilli Red, Sunrise Orange, Lilac/Cocoa, Terracotta, Cyan) with brand anchor.

Responsive alternate · Narrow cropPlacement-specific · 24 px insetCreate a separate narrow composition when responsive mobile viewports crop horizontal content.
01

Margins & safe zones

For 1080 × 600 web and app banners, start with 48 px safe insets. Keep all essential copy and logos inside them.

02

Themes & contrast

Digital web banners default to Brand Green #39823C (yellow logo, white headline). In-app promotional banners default to Brand Yellow #F3CB2D (green logo, Deep Green #214B32 headline). Category banners use complementary category themes with a clear brand anchor.

03

Category complementary colors

In category campaigns, use appetizing, culturally relevant background colors (e.g., Chilli Red for noodles, Sunrise Orange for breakfast, Confectionery Lilac for sweets).

04

Action

One descriptive action leading to a working, relevant destination.

05

Performance

Export at the required display density, set dimensions and avoid oversized raster files.

06

Truth

Show only verified claims and relevant categories. Never place unreadable conditions below a large promise.
